main.description: Get the processing status of a previously created upload. Only accessible by the DID that created the upload.

uploadId.description: The upload ID returned by place.stream.media.createUpload.

durationMs.description: Duration of the processed video in milliseconds. Present when status is 'done'.

error.description: Error message. Present when status is 'error'.

progress.description: Processing progress percentage (0-100). Only meaningful when status is 'processing'.

status.description: Current processing status of the upload.

tracks.description: Published track records. Present when status is 'done'.

errors.description: No upload exists with the given ID for the authenticated user.
errors.name: NotFound
